name: A Green Sample

angles.text: As a Mage, you know scholars have long been intrigued by the Kirin Tor’s secluded experiments and Dalaran’s botany. Unexpected corruption hints at hidden troubles within the mage enclave.
As a Rogue, you know how to slip past defenses and enter places where you are not welcome. That is why Shylamiir seeks your help.
As a practitioner of Herbalism, you learn that unnatural energies can corrupt ordinary vegetation into fel-infused blossoms in Dalaran’s central garden.

faq.answer: In Stormwind City, Shylamiir asks an outsider to enter Dalaran and gather a plant sample.
faq.q: Who gives the quest A Green Sample?

faq.answer: Shylamiir asks you to retrieve vegetation from Dalaran’s central garden, expecting a mana-infused plant.
faq.q: What does Shylamiir ask you to retrieve?

aliases: how to get fel infused blossom
faq.answer: The requested sample grows in Dalaran’s central garden, within the secluded magocracy that guards its borders from outsiders.
faq.q: Where is the requested sample found?

faq.answer: The sample is a Fel Infused Blossom, its fel taint in place of healthy mana-infused growth. Shylamiir sees the corruption as a sign that the Kirin Tor face darker troubles than expected.
faq.q: Why is the blossom fel-infused instead of mana-infused?

aliases: why does shylamiir want dalaran plants
faq.answer: Shylamiir is interested in how the Kirin Tor tend mana-infused plants. Dalaran’s interest in botany is unusual for a magocracy.
faq.q: Why is Shylamiir interested in Dalaran's flora?

faq.answer: The blossom’s fel taint startles Shylamiir, yet also intrigues them. Shylamiir praises you for completing the dangerous errand.
faq.q: What is Shylamiir's reaction to the delivered blossom?

sections.body: Shylamiir in Stormwind City seeks a traveler willing to enter restricted lands. The Kirin Tor’s interest in botany has caught Shylamiir’s attention, and a living plant from Dalaran’s central garden is wanted for study. The secluded sorcerers keep their borders closed to outsiders. Reaching the garden calls for someone able to slip past their defenses.
sections.title: An Errand to Dalaran

sections.body: The cutting from Dalaran’s central garden is a Fel Infused Blossom. Fel taint has touched its growth, where pure arcane energy was expected. The discovery catches Shylamiir off guard and suggests the Kirin Tor face darker troubles than their outward appearance reveals. That taint makes the blossom more compelling to study than ordinary arcane herbs.
sections.title: Tainted Roots

summary: In Stormwind City, Shylamiir seeks a living plant from Dalaran’s guarded garden. The cutting is wanted for study of mana-fed growth, but it brings back a darker surprise.
